highlights: Big scans keep up: on an RTX 3060, orbiting Lucy (112M) right after a stroke went from 0.7 to 51 fps, and big brushes on micro levels no longer freeze
Quick Remesh (Tool > Remesh): Shift+R or hold N to remesh the active Part, or remesh after each stroke
One-click update on Windows and the Linux AppImage, signed and checked; preferences now save themselves
Pen pressure per brush (Brush > Pen pressure), touch and trackpad navigation, and Lit Spheres you can rename and sort into folders
Rodin 2.5 in Generate 3D (fal.ai), plus Founding Members and Member Requests for members
